seed_fact: Recurring costs: hosting, domain, SSL, maintenance. Ask your designer what's included vs extra.
caption:
Think a new website is just a one‑time fee? Think again. Beyond design, you’ll pay monthly for hosting, a domain name, SSL security, and ongoing maintenance. Ask your designer what’s covered so there are no surprise bills. DM me to discuss a transparent pricing plan for your business.
